declarations.description:
A text-styled control for link and navigation actions. With `href` it renders a real anchor; without it renders a
button, so both forms keep native semantics (keyboard activation, middle-click, open in new tab).
declarations.name: LinkButton

slots.description: Icon shown after the label, e.g. a `c2-feather-external-link` for links that open a new tab.
slots.name: suffix-icon

members.name: href
members.description: Destination URL. When set (and the element is not disabled) the control renders as an anchor element.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name forwarded to the native link or button.

members.name: target
members.description: Browsing context for the link, forwarded to the anchor. Ignored when `external` is set.

members.name: rel
members.description: Link relationship, forwarded to the anchor. Takes precedence over the value implied by `external`.

members.name: download
members.description: Prompts to download the destination instead of navigating; forwarded to the anchor.

members.name: external
members.description: Opens the link in a new tab (`target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`) and shows an arrow-up-right suffix icon by default.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the control: it renders as a disabled button element (even with `href`), ignores clicks and is dimmed.

members.name: selected
members.description: Marks the current or active item (`aria-current="page"` on links, `aria-pressed` on buttons).
